sources.title: How the Retention Analysis chart calculates retention
sources.author: Amplitude
sources.notes: Defines vendor calculation behavior, not universal retention targets. Consolidated duplicate www/non-www source URL from product-growth review; former ID retained in source-aliases.json.
supported_claims: Return On differs from Return On or After; incomplete intervals change eligible denominators.
Retention requires defined start/return events and eligible cohorts
Incomplete observation intervals must be treated explicitly
Different return definitions produce different results

sources.title: What Is Sales Velocity?
sources.author: Salesforce
sources.notes: Page mixes leads/opportunities and contains 0.25% versus 0.25 example inconsistency; no benchmark or causal marketing advice adopted.
supported_claims: Sales cycle can be summarized as average elapsed days for won opportunities.

sources.title: Win Rate in Sales
sources.author: Salesforce
sources.notes: Page uses qualified opportunities; other conventions use resolved won+lost. Product deliberately defines resolved-cohort variant.
supported_claims: Denominator definitions and CRM qualification consistency matter.

sources.title: Cycle Time

supported_claims: Cycle time and production lead time need distinct process boundaries.
